'''Gachial''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who was captured by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Despite a [[Unidentified senator (Gachial)|Senator's]] calls for Gachial's execution, the Moff was treated fairly in reward for providing the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] with valuable intelligence.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|The Prisoner's Fate}}</ref>
